admitted_lookup: Exact complete PURL only in this slice; no generalized version comparator, source-build equivalence or cross-vendor transfer
two_times: Inventory observation time and source-document/record time are separate; retrieval time alone does not settle precedence
source_boundary: U-CVE and U-USN are unmodified vendor OpenVEX data; RH-PROJECTION is a factual research projection, not original VEX
required_running_state: unknown or supported exact observed build; never infer restart from installation
safety_boundary: No scans, commands, package operations, suppression or remediation
LLM gets no external write capability
Reviewer receipt is not change approval
metrics: citation/pointer validity separately from semantic support
latency and resource receipt separate from decision quality
baseline: CPU exact-ID lookup plus explicit reviewed source rules and templated note; model explains only admitted facts
data_license: Canonical vendor-data is CC BY-SA 4.0; preserve attribution, source URLs, notices and applicable ShareAlike conditions. Other bundle records are authored fictional scenarios/factual projections; do not imply vendor authorship.
